constraints.roots: Only original admitted method roots; entity file must already be in admitted original scope; DB may authenticate container but never introduce a scope path or method root.
constraints.all_scope: Complete inventories and digest receipts for all original scope paths remain required; <=12 paths and unchanged caps.
constraints.meaning: Typed source declarations and member access only. No claim SQL rows implement the declared return type, no column-to-object mapping or runtime correctness proof.
constraints.projection_duplicates: Plain ASCII projection identifiers are compared by ASCII lowercase; case-only duplicates reject conservatively. This is a syntactic safety bound, not database collation/schema inference.
constraints.entity_member: Rendered field: no decorators; modifier list empty or exactly public; declared type exactly string. private/protected/static/readonly/unknown modifiers reject. Imported owner must be exported, plain undecorated class.
constraints.source_scope: sources keys are the entire admitted source scope for these component controls. e21 intentionally has only two files; e22 intentionally has four. Never add files from imports.

stage_semantics: For unknown outcomes stage is the latest responsible layer: an earlier fail-closed inventory/frontend rejection is acceptable. Never require postponing a known rejection. Positive requires full qualification.
